label_scope: Scope-first assistant-model review of all development cases, focused semantic adjudication and root quality checks, with three user-adjudicated anchors.

audit_metadata.label_provenance: Scope-first assistant-model review of all development cases, focused semantic adjudication and root quality checks, with three user-adjudicated anchors.
audit_metadata.blinding: Readers and adjudicators received captions, condition and opaque source IDs. Original source labels and candidate predictions were withheld.

policy.scope: Finalize dispositions for the 84 previously unresolved development comparisons
policy.label_provenance: Three isolated blind contexts of the same assistant model
policy.numeric_acceptance: At least two readers independently return status rated and exactly the same numeric rating
policy.invalid_acceptance: At least two readers independently return status invalid
policy.otherwise: excluded_ambiguous, with no numeric rating and all dissent retained
policy.existing_decisions: All v1 1491 usable ratings and 255 invalid dispositions remain fixed
policy.selection_policy: Only agreement or adjudicated numeric labels enter model selection

user_review.blinding: User review followed disclosure of audit labels and reader votes.
user_review.precedence: User adjudication supplies the current rating. Historical model-reader votes are preserved.

decisions.rationale: Pie and cake are desserts under type of meal.
The sidewalk is interpreted as level ground; ascending stairs have an incline.
Number of riders counts active wave riders. Each caption describes one person riding or catching a wave.

resolution_policy.coverage: All 1830 development comparisons, including accepted and excluded cases
resolution_policy.initial_review: Six isolated model contexts; source captions and condition only; previous labels and encoder scores withheld
resolution_policy.scope_first: Record requested referent, feature and extracted values before rating
resolution_policy.second_review: Every disagreement with current V3 rating/disposition and every needs_scope result receives focused semantic review with model predictions withheld
resolution_policy.disagreement_handling: Resolve from the frozen rubric and concrete semantic values. Reader disagreement alone never establishes input ambiguity.
resolution_policy.ambiguity_exclusion: Requires recorded materially competing referents or feature interpretations that the frozen scope conventions cannot resolve
resolution_policy.invalid_exclusion: Requires concrete absent/inapplicable entity or requested feature information wholly unavailable in at least one caption; partial recoverable values in both captions can justify 3.
resolution_policy.label_freeze: Complete all semantic resolutions and hash the final audit before rescoring models
resolution_policy.preservation: Original labels, V1/V2/V3 versions, raw votes, fresh reviews, adjudication rationale and user anchors are preserved
resolution_policy.provenance: Assistant-model audit with three user-adjudicated anchors
resolution_policy.validity_clarification: Preserve Tu invalidity for wholly absent requested attributes in one caption. Broader first-draft missing-value wording was superseded before final adjudication and model scoring.
resolution_policy.grade_calibration: Retain the current V3 numeric grade when focused review explicitly classifies the difference as calibration-only and both compared entities/features are unchanged; preserve the alternative judgment in evidence.
resolution_policy.final_quality_check: Root manually checks proposed new exclusions and materially changed scopes before the audit hash is frozen.

root_quality_decisions.rationale: Snow-covered half-pipe and skiing through snow support the same cold snowy weather context, matching Tu's snow-hill inference example.
The child seated at a table with pizza and a drink supports the ordinary eating context; the comparable eaters are children in both captions.
root_quality_decisions.scope: type of child in eating context

root_quality_decisions.rationale: Unqualified object count covers the scene's described objects. Food units are indefinite in both captions, so equality is possible; arbitrary vessel-only scope is unnecessary.
root_quality_decisions.scope: all described scene objects, including food with unspecified unit counts
root_quality_decisions.value_a: bowl, plate, table and food; fine-unit total indefinite
root_quality_decisions.value_b: plate, cup, bottle and foods; fine-unit total indefinite

root_quality_decisions.rationale: Count all described room features, including doorway and window in the second caption. Its feature count exceeds the first even allowing integrated vanity or tub-shower units.
root_quality_decisions.scope: all described room features including architectural openings
root_quality_decisions.value_a: vanity, countertop, sink and commode: two to four integrated units
root_quality_decisions.value_b: doorway, window, toilet, sink and tub/shower: five to six units

root_quality_decisions.rationale: Ordinary wave riding supports an upright surfing stance, compared with an explicitly propped upper body on a surfboard. Retain the existing dissimilar-posture grade.
root_quality_decisions.value_b: upper body propped up on surfboard

root_quality_decisions.rationale: Ordinary dog tug play and nose licking support playful and affectionate social sentiment. Retain the existing closely related sentiment grade.
root_quality_decisions.scope: dogs social sentiment inferred from ordinary behavior

root_quality_decisions.rationale: Holding a child supplies a coarse body configuration in both captions. Fine adult stance is unspecified, with carrying versus table-supported holding providing partial pose correspondence.
Sunshine over snow and hikers crossing a snowfield share a cold snowy weather context; sunshine specificity differs. Retain the existing close weather grade.
root_quality_decisions.value_a: cold snowy context with bright sunshine

root_quality_decisions.rationale: A street-intersection building bearing the Swatch name reasonably supports a commercial setting, partially comparable with the grocery store; precise use remains less specific.
root_quality_decisions.value_a: Swatch-branded commercial building, exact use unspecified

root_quality_decisions.rationale: Downhill skiing and a snowboarding slope with skiers support the same ordinary cold snowy weather context, consistent with direct snow-sport inference.
root_quality_decisions.value_b: cold snowy snowboarding and skiing context

root_quality_decisions.rationale: Ordinary swing use and hanging around a pole support different grasped support structures within a common play context. Retain the existing dissimilar-object grade.
root_quality_decisions.value_a: swing support inferred from ordinary swinging
root_quality_decisions.value_b: pole inferred from hanging around pole

root_quality_decisions.rationale: A girl on a swing supports ordinary swinging motion, compared with running. Retain the existing distinct-motion grade.
root_quality_decisions.value_a: ordinary swinging inferred from girl on swing

root_quality_decisions.rationale: Marathon running implies competitive exercise, while the ordinary group-running scene supports coarse exercise purpose without establishing the same race goal.
root_quality_decisions.value_b: group running exercise; specific race purpose unknown

root_quality_decisions.rationale: Cutting wood and a nail's ordinary wood-fastening purpose are recoverable but different woodworking purposes.
root_quality_decisions.value_b: fastening wood inferred from nail against log

Pink is a lighter red-family hue, so the colors share substantial similarity with a small relevant lightness or saturation difference.

calibration_policy_repair.scope: Restore the predeclared preservation policy for 22 calibration-only judgments; preserve four genuine corrections and explicit root exceptions.

decision_records.rationale: Both judgments compare casserole with the broader baked-food category. V3 already records that precision gap, and its grade remains defensible after treating apples as secondary.
Both judgments extract casserole versus generic baked food. The focused rationale explicitly describes 3 versus 4 as category-breadth calibration.
Both judgments extract dark navy-blue sky versus dark gray sky. The rating change only reweights shared darkness against hue difference.
Both judgments extract bus versus double-decker bus. V3 already adopts the shared bus category; the focused judgment grades the same subtype specificity more harshly.
Both judgments extract bathroom versus hotel bathroom. The shared room category and hotel modifier are unchanged; 5 versus 4 reflects chosen category granularity.
Both judgments extract the same different serving vessels. The focused basis explicitly identifies degree of category similarity as the 2 versus 3 difference.
Both judgments extract food-cutting preparation with different operations. The focused basis explicitly calls 3 versus 4 cosmetic.

V3 already infers the furnished room as a living room and records the additional dining room in A. The mixed inference/calibration tag supplies identical extracted room types with a changed importance weight.
Both judgments extract jet aircraft, with private-use detail confined to A. The focused basis explicitly describes a minor specificity difference, with unchanged vehicle referents.
Lunch and breakfast are explicitly different meal categories. The current 1 applies categorical inequality to those explicitly named meal values.
Both judgments extract pizza, with specific toppings supplied only in B. The grade difference reweights that known subtype detail within the same food type.
Both judgments extract dogs, with a golden-retriever breed specified only in B. The grade difference concerns known breed specificity within the shared dog type.
Both judgments extract skateboarding, with an aerial trick specified only in A. The focused basis explicitly describes activity-subtype calibration.
Both judgments identify the same principal skateboard activity. The focused judgment grades the difference between being on a board and explicitly skateboarding as partial specificity.
Both judgments extract skateboard tricks, with a flip only in B. The focused basis explicitly permits either 4 or 5 and identifies a grading difference.
V3 penalizes vegetable-versus-fries accompaniments when comparing food type. The focused review selects the principal hot dogs in both captions and removes that incidental-food penalty.
Both judgments extract travel luggage, with suitcase specificity only in A. The partial taxonomy was already recoverable in V3 and the focused tag classifies its weight as numeric calibration.
Both judgments extract concrete-surface placement versus an airport baggage-collection area. The focused judgment changes the degree of correspondence between these location descriptions.
Both judgments extract child food handling/eating with different immediate hand movements. The focused judgment grades the same partial action overlap more harshly.
V3 already records vegetables and fish versus salad. The mixed inference/calibration rationale establishes the same ordinary served-food context and reweights dish-type differences.

V3 already records a Frisbee game with the precise Ultimate subtype specified only in A. Both versions extract the same known-versus-broad game information and differ in its degree of partial similarity.
V3 already records skis versus broader snow-travel equipment. Both versions extract the same partial type information and differ in its numeric weight.
The focused review extracts liquor as spirits, changing V3's broader unspecified-alcohol reading. Wine versus spirits is a different value comparison from specific wine versus generic alcohol.
V3 already records passenger-vehicle context with finer car specificity only in A. The focused judgment preserves those extracted values and changes the degree assigned to the precision gap.
The condition asks species, and dog versus cat establishes distinct categorical identities. The current 1 follows the requested species-identity comparison.
Both judgments extract window views with different outdoor subjects. The focused basis explicitly calls the 2 versus 3 difference calibration.
